payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_review.py::test_both_callers_refuse_a_reprompt_on_the_one_rule stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'The helper announces every re-prompt itself, so a wrong-version re-prompt emits a line too.' applied to saffron/phases/review.py as an edit. The claim was '`run_lens` and `run_wrong_versions` each hand every first answer that is not the schema to one helper, `_parse_or_reprompt` in `saffron/phases/review.py`. Through either caller, the helper re-prompts a first turn that left exactly what it spent. It refuses one that left less, and one with no session id. Each refusal files `not the schema: ` and the error, charged the first turn alone. Only the lens announces a re-prompt, and only one that fires.
